subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should modelSelectionLocked be authoritative over agents.defaults.models visibility for every trusted plugin-owned durable session, including Claude CLI and Codex harness sessions?
rationale: Preserving the persisted model repairs durable-session continuity, but it also changes the precedence of an operator-controlled model visibility boundary; repository policy requires the relevant owner and exact Codex contract to confirm that permanent invariant.

options.title: Make locked selection authoritative
options.body: Confirm that trusted locked sessions outrank generic model visibility, complete the Codex source audit, and land with effective locked and non-locked regression coverage.

options.title: Keep visibility authoritative
options.body: Require each harness or CLI backend to publish or register its persisted model through the supported visibility/catalog contract rather than bypassing the policy.

recommendation.title: Make locked selection authoritative
recommendation.body: Confirm that trusted locked sessions outrank generic model visibility, complete the Codex source audit, and land with effective locked and non-locked regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns the affected agents and subagents area to this owner.
